limitations: Eligibility and outcome knowledge is version-scoped and does not itself provide a liquidation executor.

records.claim: An active trove is eligible exactly when current ICR is strictly below MCR. Equality with MCR is not eligible.
records.currentAmounts: ICR includes pending redistribution and current accrued interest after the batch first updates trove interest.
records.modeBehavior: The same predicate is used in Normal and Recovery Mode; there is no separate current Recovery Mode liquidation branch.

records.claim: The liquidation routine returns no liquidation values when the owner array contains one or fewer troves; a batch with no successful liquidation then reverts.

evidence.locator: _liquidate last-trove guard and batch nonzero-total requirement

records.claim: For each liquidated trove the caller receives the fixed MUSD gas compensation and floor(entire collateral / 200), which is 0.5% before floor rounding.

After collateral compensation is removed, StabilityPool deposits offset debt up to available deposits. Interest is offset before principal. The pool receives a floor-rounded proportional share of liquidatable collateral.
records.partialCoverage: Partial offset is supported; remaining debt and collateral are redistributed.

records.claim: Un-offset principal, interest, and collateral move from ActivePool to DefaultPool and accrue to active troves per unit stake using error-corrected cumulative sums.
records.application: Pending rewards are floor(stake * per-unit delta / 1e18), then move back to active position/pool state when applied.

records.claim: Liquidation removes all position collateral and debt, removes the stake/list entry, and sets status closedByLiquidation. It does not burn or otherwise change MUSD already held in the borrower's wallet.
records.surplus: The current liquidation path does not account collateral surplus for the borrower.

records.claim: A caller may submit a nonempty explicit borrower list. Ineligible entries are skipped; StabilityPool capacity is consumed across successful entries in input order; the call reverts if nothing is liquidated.

rejectedInheritedRules: Recovery Mode does not change the current liquidation threshold to CCR.
There is no current special below-100%-ICR redistribution-only branch.
A nonempty StabilityPool does not imply complete offset; partial offset is supported.
Liquidation does not create a claimable borrower collateral surplus in the pinned source.
